say:1:1410548101:1.text: I can't wait to see my mirage blooms in full bloom! Who would've imagined the sunlight on the surface could be so warm...
say:1:1410548101:1.source_cn: 我的幻影花，在慢慢长大呢……谁能想到地表的阳光是如此温暖……

say:2:1410548102:1.text: I don't want to doubt Her Majesty, but it seems like she might've been hiding the truth... The surface isn't anything like she described.
say:2:1410548102:1.source_cn: 虽然很不想相信，但他们好像真的说了谎。地表根本不是女王...

say:3:1410548103:1.text: I must ask about the Divine Dew and the dragons to put my mind at ease...
say:3:1410548103:1.source_cn: 但恩典灵露和龙……我还是得问问才能死心。女王不会那么残...

say:5:1410548104:1.text: Alright, looks like we all have a reason to head back underground.
say:5:1410548104:1.source_cn: 看来咱们都有必须返回地底的理由。

choice_prompt:6:1410548104.text: Alright, looks like we all have a reason to head back underground.
choice_prompt:6:1410548104.source_cn: 看来咱们都有必须返回地底的理由。

say:7:1410548105:1.text: Do you think the High Priestess will tell me the truth?
say:7:1410548105:1.source_cn: 你们说，奎茵冕下会告诉我真相吗？

say:8:1410548106:1.text: For your sake, I hope so...

say:9:1410548107:1.text: I guess the only way to find out is by going back.
say:9:1410548107:1.source_cn: 不管能不能得到答案……现在也只有一条路，我得回去！

say:10:1410548108:1.text: I need a response, even if it's a lie.
say:10:1410548108:1.source_cn: 我需要一个回应，哪怕是假的。

say:11:1410548109:1.text: Chop chop, let's go meet those hiding in the shadows!
say:11:1410548109:1.source_cn: 那还有什么好说的呢，出发吧，会会那些躲在黑暗中的家伙们。

choice:6:0:1.text: I'll uncover the truth for Hogan.
choice:6:0:1.male: I'll uncover the truth for Hogan.
choice:6:0:1.female: I'll uncover the truth for Hogan.

choice:6:1:2.text: I'd love to see a real dragon.
choice:6:1:2.male: I'd love to see a real dragon.
choice:6:1:2.female: I'd love to see a real dragon.
